title: Regulations to Declare Eritrean Standards 33/1997
text:
LEGAL NOTICE NUMBER 33/1997
REGULATIONS TO DECLARE ERITREAN STANDARDS
1. Issuing Authority
These regulations are issued by the minister of Trade (Commerce) and
Industry, pursuant to the authority vested in him by article 18 of the Eritrean
standards institution proclamation No. 75/95.
2. Short Title
These regulations may be cited as the “Eritrean standards Regulations, Legal
Notice No. 33/1997”.
3. Definitions
In these regulations:
(a) The abbreviation “ICS” shall read “ international classification for
standards”;
(b) The abbreviation “ES” shall read “Eritrean Standard”
4. Eritrean Standards
The Eritrean Standards listed below are hereby declared to be compulsory
Eritrean standards:
